# uddns

uddns is a dynamic DNS updater with provider adapters, host selection, persisted state, safe HTTPS policy, and an MCP interface. The site documents the project and its architecture.

## Documentation

- Overview: https://bolens.github.io/uddns/
- Architecture: https://bolens.github.io/uddns/architecture.html

## Source

- Repository: https://github.com/bolens/uddns
- Issues: https://github.com/bolens/uddns/issues
